name: family-button

frames.best_why: The card is fully open with the avatar, all four menu rows and the close button visible.

tagline: Small plus button unfolds into a profile menu of account actions.
summary: A compact plus button that grows on click into a card holding an avatar, plan label and four account actions, with a round close button at the bottom.
appearance: Closed, a glossy dark rounded square holds one cyan circle with a black plus. Open, it becomes a tall dark card: avatar and name at top, four grey icon-and-label rows, and a round X at the bottom centre.
behaviour: Clicking the plus springs the square open into the full card and fades the content in after a short delay; clicking the X rotates the plus back and shrinks it to its compact size.
demo_content: Maya Chen on the Pro plan with Profile, Billing, Settings and Sign out rows.
search_phrases: plus button that opens a profile menu
expanding action menu from a small button
user account dropdown with sign out
fab that morphs into a menu card
profile menu for a web app
tiny corner button opens account options
use_when: Tuck account or action links behind one small corner control to save space in a dense app.
avoid_when: Actions need to be visible at a glance, or the menu must be keyboard reachable.
customise: Menu rows are passed as children, so any links or buttons work. Size, spring and dark colours are fixed inside the file.
weight_why: A single layout morph and a fade, idle until clicked.

a11y.note: The toggle and every menu row are divs with click handlers, so nothing is focusable or announced; no roles or labels.

issues: Menu labels sit in faint grey on near-black, hard to read.
Rows are divs, not links, so nothing in the menu is keyboard reachable.
polish_why: Layered glossy frames and a smooth morph; faint labels and div rows cost it.
title: Family Button
